CustomField.description: Used to display colored icons for engagement status using Static Resources.
CustomField.formula: IF( Blacklisted__c, IMAGE("/resource/Blacklisted", "Blacklisted", 16, 70), IF( AND( DoNotCall, HasOptedOutOfEmail ), IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Contact", "Do Not Contact", 16, 89), IF( DoNotCall, IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Call", "Do Not Call", 16, 71), IF( HasOptedOutOfEmail, IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Email", "Do Not Email", 16, 78), IF( ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Customer" ), IMAGE("/resource/Customer", "Customer", 16, 64), IF( ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Prospect" ), IMAGE("/resource/Prospect", "Prospect", 16, 60), "" ))))))
CustomField.label: Engagement Status
